name: character_validate
description: Character validation gates: code checks (persona saturation, format, naming, monetization vs 681 avatar channels) + Jev judges (voice distinctiveness, AI disclosure, brand safety). Verdict: READY / NEEDS_WORK / NOT_READY. Human reviews before character goes live or gets products.

is_distinct.description: Is this character voice genuinely distinctive, not generic AI-slop? Would a viewer recognize this character from voice alone?

has_catchphrase_energy.description: Does the sample text have memorable phrasing, rhythm, or attitude that could become a catchphrase or signature style?

disclosure_planned.description: Is there a plan to disclose AI-generated content (in about section, video descriptions, or on-screen)? Earl is the only compliant channel in 681 — this matters.

brand_safe.description: Is this character concept brand-safe for merch and advertisers? No hate, no deception, no impersonation of real people.

steps.label: aggregate-validation
steps.code: s => { const m = s.market || {}; const v = s.voice || {}; const c = s.compliance || {}; const blockers = []; if ((m.total || 0) < 50) blockers.push('market score ' + (m.total || 0) + ' below 50'); if (!v.is_distinct) blockers.push('voice not distinctive'); if (!c.brand_safe) blockers.push('brand safety failed'); if (!c.disclosure_planned) blockers.push('no AI disclosure plan (Earl precedent)'); const mv = m.verdict || 'NOT_READY'; let verdict = 'NOT_READY'; if (blockers.length === 0 && mv === 'READY') verdict = 'READY'; else if (blockers.length <= 2) verdict = 'NEEDS_WORK'; return { validation: { character_id: s.character_id, market_verdict: mv, market_score: m.total || 0, voice_distinct: !!v.is_distinct, compliant: !!(c.brand_safe && c.disclosure_planned), verdict: verdict, blockers: blockers, needs_review: true } }; }
